title: Read the intended answer with its limits
text: A headless CMS can have an administrative editor; its content delivery is decoupled from the frontend. Certificates authenticate identities and participate in TLS rather than encrypting traffic by themselves. Authentication verifies identity; authorization determines permissions.

title: Common shorthand in the review
text: Array transformation callbacks can mutate referenced data. ORM operations need safe parameter binding; raw SQL concatenation can still be vulnerable. ESLint checks code rules and likely problems, while Prettier focuses on formatting.

title: Accessibility study reference
